q1.text: When a sudden crisis occurs where a major client complains about your team's work, what is your first instinct?

options.leadership: Gather the team to immediately delegate emergency handling tasks.
options.detail: Analyze data logs and previous reports to find the exact source of the error.
options.creativity: Think of creative compensation or additional services to calm the client.
options.execution: Immediately call the client and resolve the technical issue on the spot.

q2.text: If you were asked to lead a new product launch project, which part would you enjoy the most?

options.creativity: Designing a product concept and branding strategy that has never existed before.
options.execution: Ensuring the timeline runs fast and weekly targets are met without excuses.
options.detail: Compiling detailed SOPs and checking QA (Quality Assurance) before release.
options.leadership: Motivating cross-divisional team members so that the product vision is aligned.

q3.text: Your colleague is on leave and you have to back up their work which contains hundreds of rows of spreadsheet data. Your reaction?

options.detail: Great. I like to tidy up and make sure the numbers are accurate.
options.leadership: I will delegate some parts to other staff to be more efficient.
options.execution: I'll do it as quickly as possible so today's target is still met.
options.creativity: I will try to create a new formula/macro to make the format more interesting and easier to read.

q4.text: In an annual evaluation meeting, your communication style is usually...

options.execution: Focus on action items to be executed immediately tomorrow.
options.creativity: Give wild ideas about the future direction of the company.
options.leadership: Direct the discussion so that all team members get a chance to speak.
options.detail: Bring complete notes on achieved/failed metrics and KPIs.

q5.text: What is the biggest weakness you (or others) often notice in yourself?

options.execution: Often ignoring small rules to achieve goals quickly.
options.detail: Too perfectionistic on small things so sometimes slow.
options.creativity: Often jumping from one idea to another before the first idea is finished.
options.leadership: Taking over too much work because of impatience with a slow team.
